summary: Frontend-only verification of Pulse Fitness iteration: notification bell restyle, mobile notifications panel top-24, staffing sub-tab horizontal scroll, Fleet Register CSV export, and Vehicle Fines CRUD. All primary flows PASS. Also added missing data-testid for fine-delete button (minor test-only fix).
critical_code_review_comments: VehiclesTab.js delete-fine button previously had no data-testid; test agent added `vm-fine-delete-<id>` so QA/e2e suites can assert deletion.
Confirmed StaffingConsole.js line 298 uses `flex-nowrap overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide` correctly - subtabs no longer wrap on mobile.
StaffNotificationBell button bg is transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) with white text on black nav (rgb(0,0,0)) - blends correctly.
Notifications panel on mobile now sits at top=96px (Tailwind top-24) below the black header - title 'Notifications' visible at y=97.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/LiteDashboard/staffing/VehiclesTab.js (added data-testid `vm-fine-delete-<id>` to Trash2 button on line 609)
test_credentials: portal@pulsefitness.ltd / PulseFleet123! (Pulse Fitness Ltd) - login OK, lands at /pulse LiteDashboardPage after clicking Operations from /launch launcher.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted a test fine on the first vehicle in Fleet Register (TestParking £80 2026-01-16, and Speeding £150 2026-01-15). Both were deleted after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login goes to /launch launcher; click 'Operations' card to reach /pulse LiteDashboardPage. Mobile viewport primary tab bar is horizontally scrollable and cookie banner + AI FAB (bottom-right) can intercept clicks - use JS click via evaluate() to bypass. Login rate limiter (429) trips after ~6 fast attempts.
